STEP 1 - Scene: A airline/hospital-style tray meal (sushi rolls, spring/rice-paper rolls, orange juice, soy sauce, pickled ginger) photographed from a fairly high frontal angle, roughly top-down on a tray.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The white oval plate is roughly 20 cm across (side-plate size). Plate area ≈ 3.14 × (10)² ≈ 314 cm². The tray and food sit on this plate.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Two rice-paper (spring) rolls with lettuce and filling, one whole roll on top and two more rolls together at the front (about 3 rolls total visible).
- Four small sushi rolls (maki) with vegetable filling (carrot, cucumber/avocado).
- Orange juice in a glass (not on the plate).
- Soy sauce and pickled ginger in small cups (not on the plate).

STEP 4 - Area (of plate, 314 cm²):
- Rice-paper rolls (3 pieces, ~9 cm long, ~3 cm diameter): ~22% → 69 cm²
- Sushi maki (4 pieces, ~3.5 cm diameter, ~2.5 cm tall): ~10% → 31 cm²
- Shredded lettuce under rolls: ~5% → 16 cm²

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Rice-paper rolls: 69 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 170 ml gross, but hollow-ish wrapped rolls; use ≈ 170 ml
- Sushi: 31 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 78 ml
- Lettuce: 16 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 32 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Rice-paper rolls: 170 ml × 0.5 ≈ 85 g (wrapped rolls with filling, moderate density)
- Sushi maki: 78 ml × 0.9 ≈ 70 g (rice-dominant)
- Lettuce: 32 ml × 0.15 ≈ 5 g
- Orange juice (glass ~200 ml, full): ~200 g (juice ≈ 1.0 g/ml)

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Rice-paper rolls: 85 g × 150 kcal/100g ≈ 128 kcal
- Sushi maki: 70 g × 140 kcal/100g ≈ 98 kcal
- Lettuce: 5 g × 15 kcal/100g ≈ 1 kcal
- Orange juice: 200 g × 45 kcal/100g ≈ 90 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The plated food is about 160 g and roughly 230 kcal, plausible for a light tray meal of three rolls and four sushi pieces. Adding the juice gives about 360 g and ~320 kcal total. Soy sauce and ginger are negligible (a few grams, under 10 kcal).

Estimated totals: about 160 g of food on the plate (~230 kcal), plus ~200 g orange juice (~90 kcal).
